news.title: Man killed in Tucker townhome shooting identified; 1 arrested
news.summary: A 28-year-old man faces a felony murder charge after a fatal shooting inside a Tucker home left a 29-year-old man dead Monday afternoon.

news.title: Evacuation underway on Moreland Avenue after truck leaks fluid
news.summary: DeKalb County Police officers are working at the scene of an overturned tractor-trailer leaking fluid on Moreland Avenue at Thurman Drive, leading to an evacuation within a mile radius.

news.title: Hazmat situation, evacuation after truck overturns on I-285 offramp
news.summary: Police and fire officials have lanes shut down on Moreland Avenue just off I-285 after a truck overturned Friday.

news.title: I-75 traffic stop uncovers marijuana edibles disguised as popular candy
news.summary: A traffic stop on Interstate 75 led to the arrest of a man accused of transporting a large amount of marijuana and marijuana edibles through metro Atlanta.

news.title: Man wanted for assaulting mother of his child in Atlanta
news.summary: Atlanta police are searching for Deandre Bussey in connection with an alleged domestic assault.

news.title: Man found shot to death at Evans Mill Road complex identified
news.summary: Officers found a man's body with a gunshot wound outside a DeKalb County apartment building.

news.title: Man arrested on I-75 with candy-packaged marijuana edibles
